headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.8754). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 24 studies yielded an effect size of 1.01 (95% CI: 0.9–1.14), indicating no statistically significant association between iron and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 93.88%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
